author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: Exposed Model Endpoint
challenge.description: A security audit revealed that the API gateway lacks proper authentication controls, exposing model endpoints to unauthorized access. #automation_alex# argues for keeping the gateway in a manual state to avoid disrupting the current deployment pipeline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a fully governed state to ensure compliance and security.

output.content: We are not negotiating on this. Every model release must pass through governed canary testing before it touches production. If the canary phase lacks proper governance controls, I will block the promotion immediately. This is a hard line for the architecture team. We cannot accept any risk of unvalidated models reaching end users. The deployment pipeline can be slow, but it cannot be unsafe. I will not sign off on any release that bypasses these specific validation gates. This requirement is non-negotiable for our compliance posture.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly states that the requirement is non-negotiable and defines a hard line where any bypass results in an immediate refusal to sign off, marking a limit that cannot be crossed.
